intro: Frugal Leopard's World 3 checklist. Based off of Bleak's sample progression, with additions based off of input from Eldormr, Maid, Dea, and others in the discord. Spreadsheet-ized by Perp with minor changes.
Many things will happen out of order, this is normal. This isn't a scientific list, just a cumulation of ideas.

main.text: Divine Challenge 1 - Stay on floor 1, spend 50-60k gems skipping contracts
Farm fishing upgrades until tier 2 docks
Get Cthulhu (D6 Legendary). Should be 6/87k or better, can get more rod mult/drone mult for 7/87k
While waiting for Cthulhu / Before D6T2
Slowly keep doing t2 notices to get to the bottom of the upgrades
Buy void mult from coal upgrades, aim for 8+ levels
Buy 3/3 Call of the Void skill
Prefarm fish, stars, veins and gems for d6's tribute
OB 64 - Needs a decent number of relics (~120k+) and plat craftsmanship
Invest more in fishing enhances (Prioritise T2 tick reduction, 2x ticks chance)
Push T2 docks for more fishing upgrades (Rod 59-60). Ideally, you can get both D7 and D8 to 9/87k to farm both at once.
Generator level 30 - Unlocks infernal drones after Talos 560
Can now work on remaining coal upgrades, then work on Gen 31 once they're maxed
Gild Laviathan if you have the 1.3m gems for D7T2 already
D5T2 - Do this after D7T2 if you can get 125oc Ransomite without it
9 Plat statues (can be done earlier if you have plat Ignition)
D7 Tribute 1 - Star income, needed for T2
D3 Tribute 1 - Gleaming Veins, Totem pet cap
[Optional] Gild Slug - More bomb damage/XP gain
[Optional] Get Storm Serpent (D9 Legendary) and its Tribute 1 to unlock Butterfly before BH12
Farm infernal fish (All t1 dock fish)
Unlock Butterfly pet (with either D9T1 or BH12)
Use frogspawn to level Butterfly (make sure you have 3/3 frog frenzy, poly lootfrog card)
Buy Butterfly skin - Unlocks infernal pets
Archeology - After dino quest 9-10 and all relics maxed, ascend archeology. Use tokens to unlock new idols when available.

side.title: When your Aphrodite idol is around level 400-425
items: Switch your Archaeology build to max luck, max strength, rest in agility to work on Dino quest

side.title: When your offline star income is at least 300m/hr with all items active except candy
When your offline vein income is at least 1t/hr with all items active
World 4 Prep
side.note:
Things that should be done before you're ready to tackle world 4, taken from Hayez's checklist.
Not in order, can work on many at the same time. Italics means not required, but still useful.

side.title: Infernal Fish
items: All regular fish up to dock 6

side.title: Infernal Pets
items: Dwarf - Prestige on floor 43 after buying all pickaxe upgrades. Can work on rabbit same time.
Rabbit - Prestige on floor 42 after completing 2500 contracts
Happybot - Auto xp bomb, spam prestige button as fast as possible. Can autoprestige but is much slower.
Axolotl - Obtained while farming infernal bars
Mr. Nibbles - 100% on all fish in as many docks as possible. Can use sushi if impatient.
Crab - Fire max stack of basic bombs whenever it's close to full. Bear drone can help when afk.
Nagini - Random chance from golden ore. Keep lasagna always active, auto bomb of plenty when able to.
Starfish - Random chance from super stars. Keep ice cream always active, stay on floors with stars when able.
Leprechaun - Random chance from rainbow floors. Keep lollipop always active.
Penguin - Random chance from golden floor. Avoid being on floors with lower golden floor chance when able.
Butterfly - Random chance from catching frogs. Unlikely to finish pre-w4.

side.title: These three pets all come from veins, so should be farmed together.
items: Totem - Golden veins. Farm together with Dino.
Duck - Any veins. If other two pets are done, can farm on floor 1 with spoon.

side.title:
Infernal Drones - Random chance while drone is equipped and fueled. High RNG, 10-20 days per drone average.
Once some drones are infernal, consider replacing them with less useful ones just to work on more infernals.
items: Midas - Coal capacity for more coal upgrades.
Starburst - Supergiant multi. Recommended to help with getting world 4 star card as soon as possible.
Elixir - More gem income, should always be equipped
Prism - Prismatic floor chance (Don't bother farming this pre-w4)
